LanguageData.Dovahkiin_Setting_VerboseLogging_Desc: Write extra Dovahkiin diagnostics to the log. Leave this off unless you are chasing a bug - it is noisy and costs performance.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_Need_Thuum_Tip: Thu'um: {CUR} / {MAX}\n\nSpent by shouting, restored by rest. Each dragon soul absorbed deepens the well permanently.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_Shout_Reason_NoVoice: This pawn does not have the Voice.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_Shout_Reason_NeedWord: The word for level {LEVEL} has not been found yet.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_Shout_Reason_Maxed: This shout is already fully mastered.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_StormCall_AllRoofed: The storm gathers, but every enemy in reach stands beneath a roof. Storm Call can only strike what is under open sky.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_StormCall_OutOfRange: The storm gathers, but your enemies are too far off for it to reach. Storm Call only answers near the one who called it.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_StormCall_NoEnemies: The storm gathers, and finds nothing to strike.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_SoulTear_Raised: {PAWN} rises, soul torn, and will fight for you until the body gives out.
LanguageData.Dovahkiin_SoulTear_InspectLine: Torn soul: collapses in {DURATION}. Cannot be healed, recruited or saved.
